title: Termwise tensor comparison and counit equality transport
statement: For k:X′→X, opens U and U′, and j:U′→U with hj:j≫U.ι=U′.ι≫k, transport of the derived object along hj followed by the pinned counit for U′.ι≫k, the localized target-leg tensor comparison, and the localized open tensor restriction comparison equals the pinned counit for j≫U.ι followed by the localized source-leg tensor comparison. This identity concerns only the counit family, equality transport, and underived tensor comparisons; it has no derived composition or open-pullback comparison. Definitions and ingredients: [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso], [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], [lem-pc-open-pinned-target-counit-triangle], [lem-pc-open-pinned-source-counit-triangle].

source.place: Tags 08HY, 08DW and 0D5S; derived tensor composition and restriction

proof.text: Use the proved homotopy tensor comparison coherence, which identifies the two underived comparison paths and includes equality transport along hj.

Regard the composition-pinned counit as a dependent family indexed by scheme morphisms. Generalize the two morphisms before equality induction; at reflexivity its transport identity is the identity law. The private transport_counit_comparison lemma performs this argument for arbitrary categories, families and a localization functor, then applies functoriality and the comparison identity. Instantiate it with derived pullback objects, homotopy tensor pullback objects, Qh and the pinned counit. Neither derived counit triangle theorem is used.

proof_origin.place: S2: generic equality transport of the pinned counit family, functoriality of Qh, and the proved underived tensor comparison coherence.

theorem open_pinned_tensor_counit_transport
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (k : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ k)
    (P : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun f ↦ (derivedPullback f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) hj) ≫
      (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} (U'.ι ≫ k)).app P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopyTargetCompositionIso k U').hom.app P) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopyTensorRestrictionIso k U U' j hj).hom.app P) =
    (pinnedPullbackCounit.{u, w} (j ≫ U.ι)).app P ≫
      DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((openPinnedHomotopySourceCompositionIso U j).hom.app P)
